"The boy sat on the station bench with the stolen purse in his lap. The train for the city stood hissing at the platform. All he had to do was climb in. items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the story 'The Thief's Story', and answer.

"Studies of young offenders show that many return to crime when society refuses to give them a second chance. Yet a single adult who believes in them – a teacher, an employer, a neighbour – can make a remarkable difference. Trust, it seems, is not only earned; sometimes it must be given first."

Answer the following:
(i) Who can make a remarkable difference?  (a) A single adult who believes in them  (b) A strict judge  (c) A rich friend  (d) The police alone
(ii) What does "sometimes it must be given first" mean?
(iii) Which character shows the kind of trust the passage describes?
(iv) Which word means "people who have broken the law"?  (a) adults  (b) neighbours  (c) employers  (d) offenders
items.answer: (i) (a) A single adult who believes in them (ii) Sometimes one must trust a person before they have proved themselves, so that they can change. (iii) Anil in "The Thief's Story" (iv) (d) offenders
